name: Boss dummy
source: character references/DUMMY: boss-dummy-stand.png (its colours the master's), boss-dummy-wobble-back.png and boss-dummy-wobble-forward.png (put back on the stand's colours with recolor-sprite.mjs, the stand's grid as their master: they had come back lighter and more orange), each sampled on a 3.6 px grid (the Guardian Golem's, whose design it is, drawn at his scale: its outlines come out two pixels thick as his do) and put on the stand's 32 colours; set on one canvas, the wobble back moved 27 pixels left and 1 down so that the foot it stands on stays where the stand's is, the wobble forward 3 down onto the same ground
